overview: Under the stage, in the last of the light, the roll has the cry and the flour has the sheet. You cannot see the yard from where you stand. The horses are the sound behind you.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Stood under the stage with the roll, the sheet, and the flour.

assets.name: the old Hamlet
assets.disposition: Stood under the stage with the cry on the roll
